title: Future with will
intro: Untuk masa depan, gunakan will + kata kerja dasar dengan semua subjek: I will go, she will go. Untuk bentuk negatif, gunakan won't (= will not) + kata kerja dasar: He won't be late.

exercises.question: Tomorrow she ___ call you.
exercises.explanation: Masa depan: will + kata kerja dasar. 'Will' tidak pernah berubah, bahkan dengan she.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence using the words in brackets
exercises.explanation: Negatif masa depan: won't (= will not) + kata kerja dasar: won't be.
Masa depan: will + kata kerja dasar: will study.
Masa depan: will + kata kerja dasar: will eat.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Subjek + will + kata kerja dasar + objek + waktu: We will play football tomorrow.

exercises.question: Pick the correct future sentence.
options: She will visit Bali next year.
She will visits Bali next year.
She wills visit Bali next year.
exercises.answer: She will visit Bali next year.
exercises.explanation: Setelah will, kata kerja selalu dalam bentuk dasar: will visit. 'Will' sendiri tidak pernah mendapat -s.

exercises.question: I ___ forget your birthday, I promise!
exercises.explanation: Negatif masa depan: won't = will not. 'I promise' menunjukkan keputusan tentang masa depan.

exercises.prompt: Match each sentence to its future form
exercises.explanation: Dengan will, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: She eats → She will eat, He has → He will have.

exercises.modelAnswer: Tomorrow I will visit my grandmother.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan will + kata kerja dasar untuk masa depan, misalnya 'Tomorrow I will visit my grandmother.'
